neighbours.label: taxonomic reporting of where a species is recorded or described from ('known from', 'described from', 'new records of X from'); the same prepositions in shipping, weather or fame stay low
fire: The frog is currently known only from two streams in the Andes.
A new genus of moths is described from the highlands of Borneo.
This orchid has been recorded from three islands in the archipelago.
We report the first records of the dragonfly from Sardinia.
The holotype was collected from leaf litter near Manaus.
Two new species of snail are described from caves in southern China.
The lizard is reported from dry forest along the Pacific coast.
Fossil teeth of the shark are known from Miocene deposits in Malta.
quiet: The coffee is currently imported only from two farms in the Andes.
A new line of furniture is sold in the shops of Borneo.
This orchid has been grown in greenhouses on three islands.
We report the first sales of the electric car in Sardinia.
The package was collected from the depot near Manaus.
Two new hotels have opened near the caves in southern China.
The singer is popular along the Pacific coast.
The museum in Malta displays paintings from the Miocene exhibition.

notes: Card: ' from' x14, ' of' x6, ' records', ' described', ' nov', 'nuevas' (species 'from Greece', 'New records of', 'sp. nov.', 'known from Texas', 'Flora of Zimbabwe'). Probe: 'sp. nov. is described from' 0.931, 'species of beetle from Greece is described' 0.592, 'New records of the butterfly' 0.549, 'only known from a single population' 0.452; 'olive oil from Greece' 0.042, 'known for a single hit song' 0.033, 'New records of rainfall' 0.252 (near misses avoid 'records').
